programs.name: Computer Science BSc
programs.a_level_offer: AAA-AAB, with grade B in A-Level Maths (Pure Maths or Further Maths also accepted)
programs.ib_offer: 36/666-34/665, with HL 5 in Mathematics (Analysis and approaches or Applications and interpretations)
programs.ap_offer: No course-specific AP grades are published. US route (general): a US high school diploma with 3 advanced classes (AP classes, honors or advanced classes) and/or AP tests and/or college-level class credit meets the general requirement of three A-Levels; AP 5 = A, 4 = B, 3 = C. Alternatively composite ACT or SAT: AAA = ACT 31 / SAT 1400, AAB = ACT 30 / SAT 1370. Subject requirement (A-Level Maths grade B) can be met with AP Calculus AB or BC, college-level credit in an appropriate class, or (case by case) an advanced class taken in Grade 11 or 12.
programs.required_subjects: A-Level Maths grade B (or Pure Maths / Further Maths); IB HL 5 Mathematics; GCSE English Language grade 4/C
programs.toefl_note: English language Profile B1. TOEFL iBT taken before 21 Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale): 90 overall with minimum 20 in speaking and 18 in each of writing, listening and reading. Tests taken from 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale): 4.5 overall and no less than 3.5 in any section.
programs.english_note: Exeter English language Profile B1: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall and no less than 5.5 in any section.
programs.notes: Typical offer for 2027 entry. Contextual offer: A-Level ABB-BBB or IB 32/655-30/555. Streatham Campus. A 4-year version with Year in Industry (UCAS I401) also exists. Fee is the 2027-entry international tuition fee per year as printed on the course page. AP route: https://www.exeter.ac.uk/international-students/usa/ . English profile: https://www.exeter.ac.uk/study/englishlanguagerequirements/profile-b1/ . Deadline: https://www.exeter.ac.uk/undergraduate-degrees/apply/key-dates/

programs.name: Mechanical Engineering BEng
programs.a_level_offer: AAB-ABB, with B in Mathematics, Pure Mathematics or Further Mathematics and B in another Science subject
programs.ib_offer: 34/665-32/655, with HL 5 in Mathematics (Analysis and approaches or Applications and interpretations) and HL 5 in another Science subject; IB Maths SL 7 plus HL 5 in Physics also considered
programs.ap_offer: No course-specific AP grades are published. US route (general): a US high school diploma with 3 advanced classes (AP classes, honors or advanced classes) and/or AP tests and/or college-level class credit meets the general requirement of three A-Levels; AP 5 = A, 4 = B, 3 = C. Alternatively composite ACT or SAT: AAB = ACT 30 / SAT 1370, ABB = ACT 29 / SAT 1340. Maths requirement can be met with AP Calculus AB or BC or college-level credit in an appropriate class; for programmes requiring A-Level Physics, AP Physics 1, AP Physics 2, or both AP Physics C tests (Electricity and Magnetism, and Mechanics) are accepted. For programmes with Maths and Physics subject requirements, Advanced classes are considered case by case (americas@exeter.ac.uk).
programs.required_subjects: A-Level B in Mathematics/Pure Mathematics/Further Mathematics and B in another science (e.g. Physics, Chemistry, Computing, Design and Technology); IB HL 5 Mathematics and HL 5 another science; GCSE English Language grade 4/C
